comments.body:
I have a guess, which is that this might be related to GPU memory exhaustion. Can you try lowering XLA's memory fraction (https://jax.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gpu_memory_allocation.html) to something less than 0.75?

The other thing I recommend is: try updating JAX?

The other thing I recommend is: try updating JAX?
